correctness.rationale: For each odd swap-displacement polynomial, internal ordered-pair terms cancel. The resulting multilinear coefficient of the full marked-index monomial is -n for odd subset order and -(n-2k) for even order; both nonzero on \(n>2k\). Induction recovers every intersection moment and Möbius inversion recovers every atom profile. Symmetric permutations inside atoms give orbit transitivity and round k+1 identifies all profiles. A second codebase checks 1080 coefficients and 32400 exact swap-moment identities; a direct 1-WL implementation passed 864 configurations and class-size checks. The infinite theorem is proved algebraically; the middle layer is excluded.

value.rationale: The result gives all-rank, all-individualization stabilizer-orbit exactness for a natural infinite graph family, extending a previously established rank-two classification. A uniform explicit counting-refinement depth and a full formula for orbit counts and sizes follow. Recovering all higher-order ground-membership interactions is structural, not a routine finite check or parameter tweak. The middle-layer restriction is an explicit limitation, not a claimed counterexample.
